evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-01" (a date with no time). A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null, so the date is optional.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 {"dueDate":"2026-10-05"} returned 200 with the new date. PATCH {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null (removed). Setting it again worked. PATCH /todos/3 {"dueDate":null} also removed its date.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "23.10.2026" and "2026-10-23T10:00:00" each returned HTTP 400. PATCH with dueDate "2026-13-45" returned HTTP 400.
evidence.AC4: With today = 2026-10-23, GET /todos?overdue=true returned only todo 1 (due 2026-10-01) and todo 4 (due 2026-10-05). Excluded: the todo due today, the todo with no date, and the todo due 2026-09-01 after PATCH {"done":true}, which showed isOverdue false.
evidence.AC5: Loading / showed a <time> element with each todo's date: 2026-10-01, 2026-10-23, 2026-10-05 and 2026-09-01. The todo without a date showed none.
evidence.AC6: On the list page only "past" (2026-10-01) and "none" (2026-10-05) carried the text "überfällig". The todo due today, the todo without a date and the done todo with a past date had no marker.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". After ticking it, the list showed only the two overdue todos (past and none).
